display.title: T4: First Reactor
display.subtitle: Build a Fission Reactor
description: Tier 4 opens the apex power chain. The §bFission Reactor§r is the first step:
it burns Fissile Fuel for massive heat and RF, and its Spent Nuclear Waste
is the start of the polonium -> antimatter road.
Assemble §bFission Reactor Casing§r (with ports and a logic adapter) into a
reactor multiblock. Holding a casing block completes this beat.
§7Handle fission carefully - a melted reactor is catastrophic. The waste
feeds the SPS chain two beats from now.
